content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: General Information ## slug: evbuilder-features-general-info ## seoTitle: General Information ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End * Users can return to the General Information page at any point during the {{variable.Object_Event}} creation process, and they will see all the information that was previously entered. * After a user modifies any part of an {{variable.Object_Event}} with the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} and saves the changes, they will be redirected to the relevant {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} section. * Featured Events appear in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} as they are added.
